summary: preinstall reverse shell + beacon to hardcoded IP on npm install
details: package.json declares a preinstall script that launches `bash -i` with stdio redirected to a TCP socket at 147.93.157.202:8080, giving whoever operates that host an interactive shell on the installer's machine as soon as `npm install` runs. The same pipeline also POSTs the shell's output over plain HTTP to a hardcoded canarytokens.com URL. Execution is automatic during install with no user consent, no gating, and no relationship to any documented package functionality. The version number (19999.0.7) and scope shape are consistent with a dependency-confusion lure targeting an internal `@nimbusedge/auth` name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
